rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Anne Vanderlove ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michel Adam (France, before 2011).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2014 as 'Anne Vanderlove'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-orange, yellow undertones. Strong, fruity, raspberry fragrance. up to 50 petals. Average diameter 5.5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Dark green foliage.

Height: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Christened in Vannes on May 7, 2011. Dedicated to Anne Van der Leeuw (a.ka. Vanderlove) (December 11, 1943 The Hague - June 39, 2019 Finistère), French singer and song writer
